headline: UN Committee on Global Definitions Stalls After Member Insists 'Nuclear Power' Refers Only to Kitchen Appliances
body:
The United Nations subcommittee tasked with standardizing geopolitical terminology has entered its sixth month of gridlock, following a sharp dispute over whether the term 'nuclear power' refers to uranium-enriched armaments or high-end microwave ovens. The impasse began when a senior delegate refused to sign off on a routine security communique, arguing that any country with a premium convection setup should technically be categorized as a nuclear-capable state.

"We are trying to maintain order, but the bureaucracy is effectively arguing about toast settings," said Rajeshwar Singh, a spokesperson for the administrative council. "The debate reached a fever pitch last Thursday when a representative from a landlocked nation insisted that their state-of-the-art air fryers grant them 'unparalleled deterrent capabilities' against their neighbors."

The committee has now requested an additional budget of 4.5 million dollars to hire a linguist who can clarify the difference between ballistic capabilities and programmable defrost cycles. As of Tuesday, the meeting remains suspended while delegates debate whether a toaster with an adjustable browning dial constitutes a violation of international non-proliferation treaties.
caption: When international diplomacy hits a wall, it’s usually because someone is arguing about the wrong type of power. Are your home appliances classified as international threats yet? #Geopolitics #UN #Diplomacy #Satire (satire)
